BAC carries the largest weight at 35.0%; AMD dominates risk contribution at 36.5%. On a typical bad day expect losses near 2.33% (95% VaR), with the worst 5% averaging 2.96% (CVaR) and peak-to-trough drawdown over the period of -12.64%. Action: trim or hedge AMD — it is the single biggest driver of portfolio risk.
